units.source_text: “我问K是不是和小姐一起出去的，

en.t: I asked K whether he had gone out together with the young lady,

units.source_text: K说不是，说是在真砂町偶然遇到小姐，一起回来的。

en.t: K said he had not, explaining that he had happened to meet her in Masagocho and had come home with her.

units.source_text: 我不好再问下去了，但是吃饭的时候，我还是忍不住向小姐提出同样的问题。

en.t: I could not very well press him further, but at dinner I could not help asking the young lady the same question.

units.source_text: 于是她又露出了我一向讨厌的笑容，然后才说：‘上哪儿去了？

en.t: Then she again showed the smile I had always disliked, and only then said, 'Where did we go?

units.source_text: 你猜猜看。’

en.t: Try guessing.'

units.source_text: 那时候我是个急脾气，最烦年轻女人这样不正经回答问话，马上生气了。

en.t: At that time I was quick-tempered, and when a young woman answered my questions so frivolously, it irritated me at once.

units.source_text: 但是在饭桌上能察觉到我生气的，只有夫人一个人。

en.t: But at the dinner table, the only person who noticed that I was angry was the mistress of the house.

units.source_text: K仍是那副无所谓的样子，

en.t: K remained as unconcerned as ever,

units.source_text: 而小姐这样开玩笑到底是故意为之，还是由于天真，

en.t: and whether the young lady was joking like that on purpose or simply out of innocence,

units.source_text: 我分辨不出。

en.t: I could not tell.

units.source_text: 要说小姐算是个有头脑的年轻女子，不过，

en.t: It is true that the young lady was an intelligent young woman, but

units.source_text: 我所讨厌的年轻女子的共同点，她也不能说没有。

en.t: one could not say she was entirely without the traits common to young women that I disliked.

units.source_text: 我意识到小姐这一点，却是从K来到这里之后。

en.t: It was only after K came to live there that I became aware of this side of her.

units.source_text: 我有点茫然，搞不清这感觉应该归咎于我对K的嫉妒呢，

en.t: I was somewhat at a loss, unable to decide whether this feeling should be blamed on my jealousy of K,

units.source_text: 还是应该看作小姐对我的挑逗。

en.t: or whether it should be regarded as the young lady's teasing of me.

units.source_text: 至今我也不想否认我那时的嫉妒心。

en.t: Even now, I have no wish to deny the jealousy I felt then.

units.source_text: 正如我感受过多次的那样，我清醒地意识到了这种感情在爱情中起到的作用，

en.t: As I had felt many times before, I was clearly aware of the role this emotion plays in love,

units.source_text: 而且在旁人来看，这种感情几乎总是在无足轻重的琐事上冒头的。

en.t: and to an outsider, this feeling almost always seemed to surface over trivial matters of no importance.

units.source_text: 虽说是另一个问题，可这种嫉妒心不正是爱的另一面吗？

en.t: This is another matter, but is such jealousy not the other side of love?

units.source_text: 结婚以后，我觉得这种感觉日渐淡薄下来，

en.t: After marriage, I felt this feeling gradually grow weaker,

units.source_text: 而爱情也不如以前那样强烈了。

en.t: and my love, too, was no longer as intense as it had been before.
